display-metric.purpose: The current stress percentage and other singular hero values.

page-greeting.purpose: Time-aware greeting and account name in the scenic Home header.

body.purpose: Readable, non-clinical explanations and recovery guidance.

shadows.name: tonal-card-depth
shadows.purpose: Subtle daylight card separation; night mode relies primarily on borders and tonal layering.

motion.name: quiet-state-change
motion.purpose: Card, navigation, and semantic-state changes without distracting from live wellness data.

components.name: Scenic Greeting Header
components.description: A time-aware 160-180dp header pairing a personal greeting with the matching decorative landscape and contrast-preserving scrim.

components.name: Current Stress Hero
components.description: The dominant live-data card combining score, classification, freshness, uncertainty, and watch status.

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Persistent Home, Trends, and Assistant destinations with one restored and visibly selected item.

narrative.overview: StressGuard shifts from an airy, optimistic daylight environment to a deep, restful night environment while keeping every health signal, action, and trust cue in the same place. The scenery creates atmosphere; semantic tokens and data truth remain in control.
keyCharacteristics: Automatic local-time day and night modes

rules.name: The Same Truth Rule
rules.body: Day and night may change atmosphere, never data, available actions, or semantic meaning.

rules.name: The Scenic Restraint Rule
rules.body: Illustration supports the greeting and yields to legibility; it never behaves like live weather.

dos: Do use semantic resources with day and night variants.
Do preserve 4.5:1 normal-text contrast and correct system-bar icon appearance.
Do exclude decorative scenery from accessibility focus.
donts: Don't fork features or information hierarchy by time of day.
Don't hardcode dark-only colors in layouts.
Don't label stale or simulated data as live.
